news.title: Ajay Devgn, Veena Devgan lease Juhu bungalow for ₹10.61 crore
news.para: Actor Ajay Devgn and his mother Veena Devgan have leased out a bungalow in Juhu, Mumbai, for five years, according to documents accessed by Square Yards. The lease starts at a monthly rent of ₹16 lakh and has an estimated cumulative rental value of ₹10.61 crore.

news.title: Puravankara posts ₹25.23 crore net profit in Q1 FY27
news.para: Puravankara's consolidated total income increased 62.8 per cent to ₹877.15 crore during the quarter. Pre-sales rose 28 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,439 crore, while collections increased 40 per cent to ₹1,199 crore.

news.title: Kerala: 30,000 beneficiaries to get houses under PMAY-Urban 2.0
news.para: Kerala will implement the second phase of PMAY-U, benefiting thirty thousand eligible residents.  The state government will sign an MoU with the Centre to secure central assistance.  Beneficiaries must contribute twenty-five percent of the total project cost for their new homes.  The state and Centre will jointly provide four lakh rupees for each homeless beneficiary.  This initiative aims to provide housing solutions as the first phase concludes.

news.title: Enforcement directorate conducts raids in NCR in homebuyers 'fraud' case
news.para: On Thursday, the Enforcement Directorate launched searches throughout the Delhi-NCR region as part of a money laundering investigation targeting AVJ Developers and Rudra Buildwell Construction. These companies are accused of deceiving homebuyers via a fraudulent subvention scheme, with the inquiry originating from two distinct CBI FIRs related to collusion between builders and banks.

news.title: Registry done, freehold granted, but ownership still stuck in files at Chandigarh estate office
news.para: For over fifteen years, families in Chandigarh have been grappling with exasperating delays in property mutation despite having paid all government dues and registered their sale deeds. Although their properties transitioned from leasehold to freehold, the UT estate office still withholds the crucial mutation. This bureaucratic entanglement disrupts essential transactions, such as securing loans, sales, and confirming clear ownership records.

news.title: Gadchiroli’s new regional planning authority to unlock infra potential
news.para: Gadchiroli district has been declared a separate region by the state government. A new Gadchiroli Regional Planning Authority will now guide its development. This authority replaces an outdated plan that governed the district for decades. The new body will facilitate planned land use and infrastructure development. It aims to spread industrial growth benefits across the district.

news.title: Maharashtra: IGR department proposes mandatory Aadhaar verification for property registration
news.para: The IGR department has introduced a plan to mandate Aadhaar authentication for property registrations to bolster security against impersonation and fraud. While optional currently for sub-registrars, this change entails amendments to existing laws. The state government needs to approve this proposal to implement the significant enhancement for safeguarding property transactions.

news.title: Facing backlash, Chennai civic body suspends property tax hike
news.para: In response to strong opposition from residents regarding inflated property tax bills, the Greater Chennai Corporation has suspended its revised tax for under-assessed properties. Tax amounts will revert to prior levels, with excess payments by taxpayers credited as advances. This initiative is part of a reassessment drive funded by the World Bank.

news.title: Emaar PMLA case: Tribunal upholds attachment of Koneru Pradeep’s $250,000 London policy
news.para: The Appellate Tribunal confirmed the Enforcement Directorate's seizure of an insurance policy owned by industrialist Koneru Pradeep in relation to a money laundering investigation. Despite Pradeep's claims that there were already adequate asset attachments, the tribunal found merit in the ED's tracing of premium payments to offshore funds associated with the Emaar project, which allegedly involved illicit cash collections from villa buyers.

news.title: JSW Cement posts ₹153.43 crore net profit in Q1 FY27
news.para: JSW Cement's consolidated total income increased 24.5 per cent to ₹1,970.19 crore during the quarter. Total sales volume rose 15 per cent year-on-year to 3.81 million tonnes.

news.title: Over 500 served notices for parking, building code violations in Gurugram colonies
news.para: The District Town and Country Planning (DTCP) in Gurgaon has dispatched over 500 notices for violations of building regulations. Sushant Lok-1 tops the list with 235 notices related to illegal construction and improper parking. Other areas such as Vipul World and Ardee City are also receiving significant enforcement measures. These notices highlight issues like exceeding construction limits and unlawful use of residential properties.

news.title: Delhi NCR developers tap fund houses for liquidity lifeline
news.para: Funds are partnering with Delhi NCR developers to acquire land and finish projects. This provides essential liquidity amid rising costs and market slowdown. Several developers are securing credit lines to maintain steady cash flows. Alternative Investment Funds are crucial for land acquisition in key growth hubs. Private equity inflows show a significant surge in the domestic real estate sector.

news.title: SC asks states to consider framing policy on demolition, regularisation of illegal constructions
news.para: The Supreme Court has called upon all states to develop a cohesive strategy regarding unauthorized constructions. This would encompass both the regularization and dismantling of enduring buildings across the country. The court refrained from issuing a unified policy due to differing conditions across states, instead urging local authorities to integrate the petition’s considerations into their new policies, expressing optimism for thoughtful implementation.

news.title: Delhi master plan 2047 estimates 40 lakh housing demand, banks on small-format, rental homes
news.para: Delhi's Master Plan proposes a three-pronged strategy to meet future housing needs. The plan emphasizes developing small-format affordable homes and rental housing options. It also promotes development in land pooling and transit-oriented zones. Existing housing areas will be regenerated and upgraded to improve living conditions. The strategy aims to curb unauthorized construction through disincentives and planned development.

news.title: BMC slaps ₹5.5 crore additional penalty on Taj Lands End over property tax dues; total fine ₹103 crore
news.para: Indian Hotels Company Ltd faces an additional penalty surpassing Rs 5.51 crore, further compounding existing charges related to property taxes on the Taj Lands End. Issued by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, these new claims have prompted the company to contest, asserting that there have been no violations. Consequently, the cumulative penalty now exceeds Rs 103 crore.

news.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate’s net loss widens 28% to ₹34.59 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Aditya Birla Real Estate's consolidated total income increased 30.7 per cent to ₹205.72 crore during the quarter. Its subsidiary Birla Estates has also entered the Navi Mumbai redevelopment market with a ₹2,600-crore project in Vashi.

news.title: Awfis Space Solutions’ net profit rises 140% to ₹23.96 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Awfis Space Solutions’ consolidated total income increased 27.1 per cent to ₹448.87 crore during the quarter. Its network expanded to 251 centres with approximately 1.70 lakh seats across 18 cities.

news.title: Brigade Enterprises’ net profit rises 37% to ₹216.94 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Brigade Enterprises’ consolidated total income declined 11.5 per cent to ₹1,179.22 crore during the quarter. It recorded sales of ₹1,061 crore, while average realisation increased 21 per cent year-on-year to ₹14,256 per sq. ft.

news.title: Kaara Hotels to invest ₹1,000 crore to add 120 properties in North India
news.para: Kaara Hotels plans to invest ₹1,000 crore over the next five years to expand across North India. The company aims to establish 120 properties in the region and create up to 15,000 direct and indirect jobs.

news.title: Curbs on land sale, purchase and transfer lifted in Pataliputra township
news.para: The Bihar government has lifted restrictions on land sales and transfers in Patna's Pataliputra Township, following the release of a draft development plan and official notifications. This significant change allows landowners the freedom to engage in real estate transactions throughout the township. Aiming to boost development while safeguarding stakeholder interests, this initiative brings much-needed certainty and relief to local residents and property owners alike.
